# `ci_baseline_status`

**Read the default branch's CI verdict.** Judge the head commit's check runs, name the failing checks and tests, and derive the repair task keyed by their failure signature.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `ci_baseline_status` |
| Side effect | `read` |
| Idempotency | natural |
| Retry safe | yes |
| Timeout | none |
| Preview | not supported |
| Defined in | [`src/commands/contracts/builtin.py`](../../../src/commands/contracts/builtin.py) |
| Contract fingerprint | `sha256:a8bc85c6eceb60bcc0a7c4d235d38758456bd15cc1d82c74e3826f661c30c239` |
